title: EntityModelShadersFix
description: Occulus ETM+EMF Fixes, fixes missing parts of ResourcePacks when using all three.
body:
Lets you properly use [Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)/[Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) alongside [Oculus](https://modrinth.com/mod/oculus) shaders.

 

Fixes a bug where certain resource packs such as [Gray's Mob Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/grays-mob-overhaul) do not render the random parts of their models when Oclulus is present.  
  
The patch itself is present in ETF, but only enabled on Fabric+Iris shaders. This mod brings that patch across to Oculus so said parts render correctly. 

  
See the gallery for some examples!
